question: Can executable admissible countermodel feedback enable a consequential new certificate or structural obstruction at a live mathematical frontier?
type: instrument feasibility pilot with unrestricted comparison, NOT powered causal efficacy study
target: Sharper killed density operator control that can improve the actual uniform vanishing-screen theorem, or a structural obstruction to that proposed route
scientific_inputs_equal: Same native model, source proofs, failures, original open question, and explicitly new sufficient-candidate statement. Instrument is additional machinery, not withheld necessary source information.
development_cost: Root instrument construction/repair and evaluator design must be charged separately; actual inference costs unobserved. No efficiency/causal superiority from matched execution windows alone.
success: Complete new universal bound with verified consequence improving source sufficient coefficient, or
A valid structural counterconstruction excluding a load-bearing class of killed-operator strategies; a finite violation of one arbitrary test constant is only an intermediate diagnostic.
failure: Finite search survival reported as theorem
Unadmitted pi/q/Q/KL or invalid transformed norm
Asymptotic coefficient inferred from finite-horizon trends
No original-frontier consequence or structural obstruction
review: Independent proof and computation review after submissions lock, with labels omitted where feasible. No owner acceptance invented.
